# News {.unnumbered}

Each released version of the book has an entry here that says what changed since the version before it, so you can check whether something you read has since been corrected. Earlier versions stay online and can be opened from the version menu in the sidebar.

## Development version {.unnumbered}

The version we are working on. Nothing has been released yet. Online now: the welcome page, Chapters 1 to 5, and Appendices A to D.

Changes so far:

- 30 October 2026. Every code chunk that simulates now starts with `set.seed(84735)`, so you can run any chunk on its own and get the numbers printed in the book.
- 30 October 2026. Chapter 1: the proposal density in rejection sampling is now written $q$, as in the notation appendix; Exercises 1.3 and 1.8 changed accordingly.
- 30 October 2026. Chapter 3: the chain and grid-walk functions take `n_iter` instead of `T`, the same argument name as the samplers of later chapters; Exercise 3.5b now says that the entry $P_{\text{happy},\text{sad}}$ is changed to 0.01, and Exercise 3.8b uses `n_iter`.
- 30 October 2026. Chapter 4: the precision target for the endpoints of the credible interval is now 0.01 instead of 0.005, and the output of Stan's diagnostic check is shown.
- 30 October 2026. Chapter 5: the two-mode example now has its modes at $-5$ and $5$ instead of $-3$ and $3$, so that a small step size really does trap the chain; Exercise 5.7a starts its chains at $-5$ and $5$. The Metropolis sampler now stops with a clear message when the log target returns `NaN`.
<!-- dev-end -->
